messages:
jess (devex): Cutting the py/ts SDK GA now — quiet window in effect. I’ll run the publish pipeline and tag canary->stable.
liam (release): thanks. I'll watch for signer drift; ping me if twine/npm reject.
omar (pkg): @jess push creds? I see pypi token scoped to legacy org, may need rotate.
jess (devex): uploaded wheels to staging, npm packages published to staging registry. starting prod now.
deploy-bot: Publish job #4321 started — py/ts-sdk v1.4.0 -> prod
sasha (qa): quick smoke: python import and basic gen ok on canary. failing: ts client runtime throws ESM import error for one build.
omar (pkg): saw the ESM error locally, fixed in 1.4.1 candidate. holding prod tag until patch.
jess (devex): re-run publish for ts only? we can pin v1.4.0 for py and skip ts until fix.
liam (release): decision: rollforward for python, holdback ts. We'll pin npm dist-tag 'latest' -> 1.4.0 and keep npm:canary for ts.
omar (pkg): commands below:
```
# pin latest to 1.4.0
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@1.4.0 latest
# pypi already uploaded (twine upload out to prod)
```
jess (devex): done both. Updated release-notes draft: removed TS breaking note and added deprecation blurb for old sync-client. @nora can you publish docs update?
nora (docs): on it, putting a note under migration guide + changelog. will include examples.
sasha (qa): re-tested TS fix, looks good in CI; recommend a follow-up patch release and a soft-deprecate note for old API.
liam (release): okay we’ll schedule TS 1.4.1 in the next quiet window. For now, propagate pinned versions to internal mirror and update release channels.
deployops-bot: Mirror sync started -> internal registry
jess (devex): One more: reminder to tag the release in repo and attach signed changelog. I'll do the git tag and upload signatures.
jess (devex): summary: py GA live (1.4.0), ts held (canary -> fix -> 1.4.1). No rollback. Closing thread.
